architecture.summary: Documents and an operator tool only. SO-12 part B records the rehearsal in docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s2-release.md: the application checks of section 1.4; run 1, which stopped at R1 because the Git build of the staging control plane failed one timing-dependent acceptance case in the check stage of Dockerfile.hosted on the builder of Render, with its cleanup; the manager decision of 31 October 2026 on a changed order; and run 2, in which R1' to R14 and the cleanup passed (Render accepts the switch of a Git build service to the image and back, a variable update starts no deploy, the fleet commands, the signup, the suspend and resume, the upgrade, the removal, and the rollback work on thermus-spike-* services). The Part B findings name the stale marker of example.com, the window of about 75 s after live in which a new tenant refuses calls, and the two provisioner loops during the overlap of a control plane deploy; their consequences go into steps 6 to 8 of the production order and item 15 of the owner steps, and docs/free-subscription-guide.md gets the current words of the test call. It adds the rehearsal helper script/release/rehearsal/, its knip entry and its section in script/README.md, and one row in the Containers and source owners table of architecture/components.md. The helper is outside src and no component: it composes the public bounded SQL runtime of sql and the hosted live test support, and calls the Render and WorkOS APIs itself. No source, test, workflow, migration, or Mermaid block changes, so no component, edge, public module, declaration, or runtime behavior of a server changes.
